evidence.claim: Traild leverages AI-powered Natural Language Processing (NLP) and OCR to extract line-level details from complex or handwritten supplier invoices, providing 90% accuracy on first-time reads from new vendors and climbing to 99% accuracy by the second read due to its continuous machine learning engine.

Traild's web interface displays a side-by-side view where clicking fields highlights extracted boxes in red, allowing manual corrections that the system memorizes to deliver 95% out-of-the-box accuracy across its multi-million invoice training network.

The software features custom multi-level digital routing that automatically triggers fast-track approvals for low-risk or PO-matched invoices while directing anomalies via built-in conditional workflows optimized for mobile, desktop, and tablet layouts.

Custom routing parameters can be tailored dynamically across specific dimensions including supplier identity, corporate location, General Ledger (GL) codes, absolute invoice value, and distinct job or project subtask codes.

Traild features native real-time two-way synchronization capabilities supporting direct operational mappings for ERP platforms including Acumatica, MYOB Advanced, Syspro, IFS, SAP Business One, NetSuite, and Xero.

For SAP Business One environments, its pre-built integration module executes synchronized batch uploads that dynamically tie together master vendor profiles, open purchase orders, invoices, general ledger updates, and executed payment logs.

Traild integrates a 24/7 automated monitoring engine that actively executes cross-economy network intelligence scans to verify supplier bank details, flags altered payment terms, and prevents duplicate or unauthorized payments.

The core platform incorporates automated 2-way and 3-way line-by-line verification loops that compare live invoices against matching purchase orders, goods receipts (GRNs), and historical sub-contract documents.

Traild expands global processing operations using its built-in Traild Pay transaction network, which scales single-click cross-border disbursements to handle vendor payments across 60+ currencies spanning 150 countries.
The technical architecture handles variable multi-entity transaction volumes while protecting underlying financial data layers under formal SOC 2 and ISO 27001 organizational security certifications.

The company reports that its data extraction engine utilizes artificial intelligence, machine learning, and natural language processing to extract header and line-level data from standard, complex, and handwritten invoices.
Customer reviews published on the Xero App Store indicate that the system provides accurate line-level data capture and automated coding via its machine learning-enabled invoice capture.
